objective: Maximize legitimate discoverability, verified external citations/references, and meaningful LLM/search surfacing as quickly as safely possible toward the portfolio 100K objective.
truth_boundary: 100K is an acceleration target, not a guaranteed outcome and not a page quota.
required_strategies: semantic clustering and duplicate suppression before route admission
citation magnets including frameworks, decision matrices, checklists, reference assets and sourced syntheses
machine-readable semantic HTML and valid structured data
measured feedback from indexation/search/LLM surfacing/external citations
storage_policy: Use compact deterministic generation plus compressed sharded materialization; repository byte size is not a fanout KPI.
publication_policy: Opportunity != page. Existing admission, source, similarity, safety and validation gates remain authoritative.
